notes.title: 'Emergency Update' - A ship is crashing on the horizon.
notes.content:
[h2]We are introducing a new update 'Emergency Update' to fix reported bugs and add new features to the game.[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45527606/aa82c23707ce38cb790b41789af375888726c585.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]

Message from the Developer:
Thank you so much for your support throughout the development of The Survivor. We're incredibly grateful to everyone who reported bugs and suggested features to be added to The Survivor — We hear your feedback!

[hr][/hr]

Patch Notes:
[list]
[*] Reworked the guidebook into a futuristic HUD-based guide that works with proximity to each interactable item in the ship.
[*] The ghost now [spoiler]inverts the player camera controls for 10 seconds[/spoiler] to make it more challenging for players.
[*] Expanded and changed the layout of the ship into stations to make it easier to navigate and control the ship.
[*] Added a graphic setting {Low, Retro, High} in the main menu.
[*] Reworked The Outsider (Intruder) behavior.
[*] Reworked some modifiers, and others are now less aggressive.
[*] Removed ship malfunctions.
[*] Added FuseMaster Model B to be the main method to fix power downs.
[*] Added a dim light around the player to help with the visibility in extreme darkness.
[*] Changed some security camera angles.
[*] Changed some galaxy point names.
[*] Updated the main menu view.
[*] Objective and extra instructions are provided in the starting text.
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[b][i]This update does not require manual action; just restart Steam to automatically get the latest update.
[/i][/b]
As always, thanks for playing and supporting us! If you find any more bugs or issues, feel free to share them in the community or join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/atNX56k5n7]🎙️ Official Discord Server[/url].

– Cyber752 Games

notes.title: The Survivor is OUT NOW — Do You Have What It Takes to Survive?
notes.content:
[h1]The Survivor has officially emerged from deep space!  [/h1]
[h3]The Survivor has officially launched on Steam — face the relentless horrors of the galaxy and prove that survival isn't just luck... It's resource management.[/h3]

Thank you so much for your support throughout the development of The Survivor. We're incredibly grateful to everyone who played the demo — your feedback and passion truly empower us to keep building brutal, atmospheric experiences that push players to the edge!

[previewyoutube=3g5kxrJWn-8;full][/previewyoutube]

[*] 🛠️ Manage critical ship systems: oxygen, power, and integrity.
[*] 🧠 Tense survival horror with resource management.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3549320/The_Survivor/
